I’m a penetration tester, bug hunter, and security automation builder. Online, I go by raahilmw.

I’m interested in the assumptions hiding inside everyday features. One of my writeups started with a simple question about an image fetcher: what could the server read?

I document the behavior I can verify and build tools for the parts of an investigation I repeat.
